title: Book Two · Chapter 16: Not a Baby Book
story:
Jun's grey book lies open on Tuesday morning. The letters are large. A picture fills half the page.

Ronan looks down at it.

“That is a baby book.”

Jun closes his book.

“It is mine this week.”

“I mean the big letters.”

“I like them.”

Jun puts the book in his bag. He takes out his sums instead. Ronan sits down beside Leo.

Leo is working on a number line. He has a little mistake near the middle. He rubs one mark out and makes another.

“Can you read this word?” Ronan asks.

He holds out his green book. The word is sign.

“Not now,” Leo says. “I need to finish this.”

“It is only one word.”

Leo keeps his pencil on the number line.

“After this, perhaps.”

Ronan pulls the book back. The goat still has paper in its mouth. He can understand that picture. He cannot yet read all the words beside it.

Miss Wu begins the lesson. The books go away. For the next hour, there are numbers on the board and no goats.

At break, Jun sits on the low wall with his grey book. He reads a line, looks at the picture, and laughs.

Ronan stops nearby.

“What is funny?”

Jun turns one page. He does not answer at once.

“A man goes fishing,” he says at last.

“Does he catch a big fish?”

“He thinks so.”

Ronan steps closer. The man in the picture is pulling very hard. His feet are wide apart. The end of the line is still under water.

“Can I see the next picture?”

Jun keeps one hand on the page.

“You called it a baby book.”

“I was rude,” Ronan says. “I want to see the fish.”

“There isn't a fish.”

Jun lifts his hand. Ronan turns the page. The man holds a large old shoe. A little fish looks up from beside the boat.

Ronan laughs. He points to the long fishing line.

“The shoe is bigger than the fish.”

Jun nods. “There is another shoe later.”

“On the other foot?”

“No. Read it another day.”

He puts his finger between the pages. Ronan gives the book back.

After school, Leo finds Ronan at the gate.

“The word is sign,” he says. “On your goat page.”

Ronan takes the green book out. He reads the word after Leo. Then he reads the whole sentence.

“Does your goat eat the sign?” Leo asks.

“Yes.”

“Better story than my numbers.”

At home, Ronan reads the page to Mum. She sits beside her sewing box. He stops twice, then starts those lines again.

Mum looks at the farmer's new paper.

“He needs a higher wall.”

Ronan turns the page. There is another sign near the ground. The goat is already beside it.

“Not yet,” he says.

Mum reaches for her thread. Ronan leaves her to work and reads on. At the bottom of the next page, he finds the farmer beside a ladder. He puts one small paper strip there and takes the book to his bed.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

large＝大的；rude＝失礼的；page＝书页；sign＝告示牌。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan说了什么话，让Jun不愿分享书？
2. 两人后来怎样重新谈起那本书？

## 读句子

**Jun / closes / his book.** Jun／合上／他的书。
